# PPC Consultancy (ppcconsultancy.uk)

> Diego Zietek, independent PPC consultant with 14+ years of hands-on work, for UK and Irish businesses. Runs Google, Microsoft, Meta and LinkedIn Ads personally, with landing pages and conversion tracking included, for a flat monthly fee in pounds. Based in Curitiba, Brazil; works remotely on UK hours, in English.

- Market: UK and Irish businesses; the US and Canadian practice is at googleadsfreelancer.com.
- Services: PPC management, PPC audits, B2B PPC, landing pages and conversion tracking (GA4, Tag Manager, Consent Mode v2).
- Pricing: quoted in pounds, ex VAT, from the form; prices are not published. Never a percentage of ad spend.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/): Independent PPC consultancy for UK and Irish businesses.
- [PPC management](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ppc-management/): Google, Microsoft, Meta and LinkedIn under one measurement layer, with pages and tracking in scope.
- [Google Ads consultant](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/google-ads-consultant/): Strategy, a second opinion or a full review of the account, from the person who would run it.
- [PPC consultation](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ppc-consultation/): A one-off working session on your account, with written notes, before or instead of a retainer.
- [PPC audit](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ppc-audit/): Fixed-price account audit with fixes ranked by financial impact. Yours to keep.
- [PPC freelancer](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ppc-freelancer/): A senior freelance PPC specialist for UK businesses, hired directly.
- [PPC specialist](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ppc-specialist/): A senior specialist on the account, not an agency team: what that means in practice and how to check it.
- [PPC consultant, London](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ppc-consultant-london/): For London businesses, delivered remotely on UK hours.
- [B2B PPC](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/b2b-ppc/): Search and LinkedIn for pipeline, with CRM stages fed back to the platforms.
- [SaaS PPC](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/saas-ppc/): Google and LinkedIn Ads for software companies, measured in qualified pipeline and payback, not sign-ups.
- [E-commerce PPC](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ecommerce-ppc/): Shopping, Performance Max and Meta for online stores, measured on margin and new customers.
- [PPC for law firms](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/ppc-for-law-firms/): Google Ads for solicitors: paying for instructions, not for people comparing fees.
- [Healthcare PPC](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/healthcare-ppc/): Private clinics, dental and healthcare brands: enquiries that become appointments, within Google's health policies.
- [Landing pages](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/landing-pages/): One page per intent, built to the ad, tracked before it goes live.
- [Conversion tracking](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/conversion-tracking/): GA4, Tag Manager, Consent Mode and offline import, so the platforms optimise towards customers.
- [Pricing](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/pricing/): How UK PPC work is charged, what it typically costs, and my fees.
- [Results](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/results/): Published results, their limits, and what carries over to a UK account.
- [About Diego](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/about/): The consultant behind this site, and how a UK engagement works.
- [Contact](https://ppcconsultancy.uk/contact/): The form or an email, both answered by the consultant.
